thag8.1:1.1: One should not do much work
thag8.1:1.2:
One should avoid people,
One should not bustle (to obtain gifts).
thag8.1:1.3: One who is eager and greedy for flavors
thag8.1:1.4: Misses the goal that entails happiness.
thag8.1:2.2:
this homage and veneration
Obtained among devoted families.
thag8.1:2.3: A subtle dart, difficult to extract,
thag8.1:2.4: Honor is hard for a vile man to discard.
thag8.1:3.1: It is not on account of another
thag8.1:3.2: That a mortal's kamma is evil.
thag8.1:3.3: On one's own accord one should not resort to evil,
thag8.1:3.4: For mortals have kamma as their kinsmen.
thag8.1:4.1: One is not a thief by another's word,
thag8.1:4.2: One is not a sage by another's word;
thag8.1:4.3: It is as one knows oneself
thag8.1:4.4: That the devas also know one.
thag8.1:5.2: That we all come to an end here.
thag8.1:5.3: But those wise ones who understand this
thag8.1:6.2: Even despite the loss of his wealth.
thag8.1:6.3: But if one does not obtain wisdom,
thag8.1:6.4: Then even though rich one is not alive.
thag8.1:7.1: One hears all with the ear,
thag8.1:7.2: One sees all with the eye,
thag8.1:7.3: The wise man should not reject
thag8.1:7.4: Everything that is seen and heard.
thag8.1:8.1: One with eyes should be as if blind,
thag8.1:8.2: One with ears as if deaf,
thag8.1:8.3: One with wisdom as if mute,
thag8.1:8.4: One with strength as if feeble.
thag8.1:8.5: Then, when the goal has been attained,
thag8.1:8.6: One may lie upon one's death bed.
